title: Slow English Podcast #297: Gyeongju - South Korea 🇰🇷

sentences.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak very slowly.
Jungju is full of tradition and nature.
Part two, South Korea and Asia.
South Korea is a country in East Asia.
It is also a very old country.
South Korea has mountains and sea.
Jungju is in the east of South Korea.
It is not far from the sea.
The city is not very big.
There are hills and fields around the city.
Many places are near each other.
People change life with the seasons.
Long ago, it was the capital of the Silla Kingdom.
This was more than 1,000 years ago.
The city was rich and powerful.
Today you can still feel this past.
The tombs are part of daily life.
They are in parks and open areas.
One famous place is Bulguksa Temple.
The temple is in the mountains.
The place feels peaceful and deep.
Part eight, Sokram Grotto near Bulguksa.
Inside there is a stone Buddha.
The Buddha is calm and strong.
It is very important in Korea.
Part nine, Daily Life in Jungju.
Daily life in Jungju is slow.
Nature is part of the city.
The city feels open and calm.
Part twelve, Feeling, Tradition and Goodbye.
Jungju is a city of ancient history, temples, royal tombs, nature and slow life.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
See you in the next episode.
